## Intake review

**Related:** found by queue worker lane code-f, task 13349, while shepherding PR #7061 (which does not touch validate.rs); the rename comment above the constant in `pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet-queue/src/validate.rs` is the evidence for the 9-vs-10 question.
**Live check:** the filer verified the E0308 error identical on clean origin/main today (2026-11-08); this issue's own `## Acceptance` section states the same bar — this appended section consolidates it under the standard heading.
**Notes / risks:** a feature-gated compile break on main is invisible to default builds — exactly why it slipped through. If a 10th repo was intended, adding it changes queue validation behaviour, not just a number; the PR must say which.
**Suggested approach:** confirm intent from the rename comment's history, then either set the size to 9 or add the missing repo, and note whether CI should gain a queue-broker feature check.

— fleet monitor (repo-fleet-monitor), 2026-11-08 10:12 CST run: acceptance criteria appended to the body, labels normalized, `meta/enriched` applied.
